text: Subject: Duplicate charge. The billing page shows two settled payments for the October renewal. The customer has attached redacted receipts with different transaction IDs. They want one charge refunded and confirmation that their subscription will stay active.

Subject: Invitations missing after domain migration. The workspace changed its primary domain on Monday. Existing users can sign in, but five new employees say their invites never arrived. The admin resent two invites and checked spam. An invite sent to a personal mailbox did arrive. The mail team recently enabled a quarantine policy for lookalike sender domains and asked support to provide timestamps and message IDs. The customer needs a workaround for Wednesday onboarding and wants to avoid creating duplicate accounts.

Subject: Weekly export is incomplete. Finance scheduled a CSV export every Monday at 09:00 local time. The file from this week opens normally but is missing several rows for refunds posted on Sunday evening. The transactions are visible in the dashboard when the date range is set manually. A rerun using the saved report produced the same result. The first support agent noticed that the export definition uses UTC and the dashboard uses the account timezone. The customer says the previous three exports reconciled and that the timezone was changed two weeks earlier during an office move. The finance lead attached reconciliation totals, asked for a corrected export before quarter close, and wants a clear explanation of which timezone governs future scheduled reports. Engineering has requested the report ID and the timestamp when the timezone was updated.
